newsitem.title: USA: Darling Intl in $225 mln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Darling Intl in $225 mln credit pact.

text.p: Darling International Inc said Friday it has a $225 million agreement with a BankBoston Corp unit to refinance all existing senior and subordinated debt.

The company said the agreement for a new five-year facility allows it to retire all its existing bank debt as well as its 11 percent subordinated debt. It will also allow it to finance internal and external growth, it said.
The company said the new facility was syndicated by BankBoston Securities Inc and will be agented and administered by BankBoston.
The move is expected to generate significant interest cost reductions, the company said.
